explanation: The original module had two functional defects: (1) The synchronous reset block only cleared wr_ptr, leaving wr_ptr_cur and drop_frame uninitialized, which violates the requirement that reset flushes packet pointers and partial/drop state. (2) The frame commit logic incorrectly updated wr_ptr to wr_ptr_cur + 1 instead of wr_ptr_cur, causing an off-by-one error that reduced FIFO capacity by one slot and distorted full/empty flags. The edits add the missing resets and fix the commit pointer assignment.
